bullets.title: AVGO: UBS reiterates Buy at $470 PT; AI revenue guidance conservative, XPU moat underappreciated
bullets.body: UBS NDR takeaways: AVGO F2027 AI revenue to 'at least double Y/Y' and F2028 to at least double again, with guidance viewed as conservative. XPU roadmap scaling from 4 to 8/16 dies with integrated SRAM and ARM cores; 448G SerDes and vertically integrated packaging create moat vs. ASIC competitors. AVGO seeking $60B in borrowings (per separate reports) to fund Anthropic chip access; company clarifies it's contributing to third-party lending platform with limited residual-value guarantees, not direct financing. PT $470 on 17x/30x EV/FCF on CY27E Software/Semis FCF.

bullets.title: MRVL: Piper bullish ahead of Oct 6 investor day; $45B revenue / $19 EPS power by FY31 flagged
bullets.body: Piper expects MRVL management to introduce a new long-term financial model at the Oct 6 investor day potentially stretching to FY31 with $45B revenues and ~$19 EPS power (45% CAGR). Analyst highlights 'XPU Attach' opportunity as underestimated, drawing analogy to GOOGL's $120B TPU deal as a proxy for hyperscaler datacenter opportunity. MRVL is a tactical positive per Piper.

bullets.title: STX/WDC: Each down 8-11% pre-market on Toshiba doubling HDD production in FY27
bullets.body: Toshiba announced it will invest ¥60B (~$380M) to expand its Philippines factory, targeting a doubling of HDD production for data centers by FY27 and ~30% market share (vs. ~10% now). STX -10.7% and WDC -7.9% in pre-market on the supply shock news.

bullets.title: NVDA: MS reinstates as Top Pick; JPM bullish on data center bottleneck narrative; semis broadly higher pre-market
bullets.body: Morgan Stanley's Joe Moore reinstates NVDA as Top Pick citing data center buildout as a new bottleneck and 'undemanding multiples' at 15x FY28 EPS with multiple expansion potential; NDR highlights diversity beyond hyperscalers. JPM notes NVDA +1.7% pre-market as the Mag 7 outperformer, with Semis broadly up (AMD +2.2%, INTC +1.9%, TXN +2.0%, MRVL +2.4%). Separately, Amazon is seeking to offload ~$8B of Nvidia Grace Blackwell chips via SPV to lighten balance sheet.

bullets.title: GOOGL: JPM bullish on TPU monetization; $100B EBIT potential from Anthropic ramp, mid-$20s 2028 EPS bull case
bullets.body: JPM sees TPU sales to Anthropic ramping 1 GW (2026) → 5 GW (2027) → 10 GW (2028), potentially generating ~$100B EBIT vs. Street's $270B 2028 EBIT estimate. Bull case 2028 EPS mid-$20s vs. Street ~$18. Gemini 4 brings GOOGL back to frontier-competitive level; Gemini Spark agent rollout imminent with ads coming to Gemini app in 2027. Separate Seeking Alpha note flags Google's distribution advantage embedding AI in Search, Gmail, Docs as key moat.

bullets.title: META/MSFT: Viewed as 'alpha dogs' and attractively valued; META faces $40B New Mexico privacy penalty
bullets.body: Multiple sources flag META and MSFT as top large-cap tech longs: Hedgeye calls them '2 alpha dogs in mega-cap tech,' Hedgeye risk ranges show both bullish. Separately, Ed Elson (Seeking Alpha) views Meta's focus on practical AI agents as superior strategy. Risk: Meta faces a $40B penalty demand in a New Mexico privacy violation case.

bullets.title: ACN: Beats Q4 by wide margin; stock +15.8%; analysts raise targets to $220-$242
bullets.body: Accenture Q4 revenue $18.68B beat guidance of $17.75-18.4B; EPS $3.29 vs. FactSet $3.18. Bookings $22B with 37 deals above $100M; AI-related revenue doubled y/y. FY27 guidance: revenue growth 3-6% local currency, EPS $14.39-$14.81. RBC raises target to $240, Stifel to $242, Truist to $220; Citi raises TP to $220. Consensus now 42% buy / 54% hold. NTM P/E at 14.4x vs. 5-yr avg 23.0x — cheap on history.

bullets.title: TSM: N3 tightness worsens in FY27 on NVDA/Google/AWS demand; 29% revenue growth expected FY27
bullets.body: JPM notes TSMC expects 3Q revenues $45.8B (+14% QoQ) at the high end of guidance with 66.8% gross margins. N3 tightness modeled to worsen in FY27 and only ease in FY28. FY27 ASP growth +27% with revenue growth +29%; broad wafer price increases (N3/N2 ~10%, N7+ low-mid single digits). Key catalysts: 3Q early revenue release Oct, ASML results Oct 14, full 3Q results Oct 15.

bullets.title: DKNG: DKeX grew 22x MoM in September; prediction market volume $76.6B; Hedgeye maintains Short Bias
bullets.body: DKNG's DKeX prediction market exchange grew 22x MoM to ~$2B in contracts in September, reaching 2.8% market share; industry monthly volume $76.6B (+64% MoM). DKNG projects monthly combo volume of $350-420M by year-end with NBA season as next catalyst. Despite the growth, Hedgeye maintains Short Bias on DKNG with 'most challenging setup into Q4 2027.'

bullets.title: AMZN/MSFT: EU DMA gatekeeper designation for Azure and AWS expected as early as November
bullets.body: EU regulators finalizing determination that Azure and AWS meet DMA gatekeeper requirements; decision expected November 2026 following June preliminary ruling. If confirmed, both companies have six months to comply. Non-compliance fines up to 10% of worldwide turnover (20% for repeated infringement); Commission can also impose forced business sales for systematic infringement.

bullets.title: MU: Memory supply/demand tighter through 2027-28; HBM pricing rising significantly in 2027
bullets.body: Micron guided that 2027-2028 memory supply/demand will be much tighter than 2026, with HBM pricing expected to increase significantly in 2027. DRAM pricing up high-teens q/q, NAND up ~30% in the most recent quarter. CXMT (Chinese DRAM supplier) planning NAND market entry remains in R&D phase; meaningful greenfield capacity not expected until 2H28+.

bullets.title: CVNA: JPM raises 3Q26 EBITDA to $825M on 40% unit growth; cuts 4Q/27 on GoS margin pressure from higher rates
bullets.body: JPM raises 3Q26 EBITDA estimate to $825M vs. consensus $793M on unit growth of 40% vs. 38% prior, but cuts 4Q26 EBITDA to $695M and 2027 to $4,125M reflecting ~100bps+ rate increases since 1Q26 compressing GoS margins (~25bps spread compression = ~50bps GoS margin). AI/agent competitive risks viewed as overblown. Maintains Dec 2027 PT of $100.

bullets.title: NOW: Partner channel checks show healthy but uneven growth; deal cycles lengthening 3-4 months on AI ROI scrutiny
bullets.body: JPM partner feedback: ServiceNow revenue growth 5-24% y/y in Q3 2026, with enterprise partners strongest at 20%+ but some segments flat to -5%. Renewal retention near 100%; deal sizes expanding 10-20% with Advanced tier at 30-40% pipeline penetration. Deal cycles extending to 6-9 months in manufacturing on CFO AI ROI scrutiny. July 1 SKU price increases of 12-15% implemented; platform consolidation is single most powerful growth driver.

bullets.title: HPE: Morgan Stanley raises PT to $72; networking emerging as faster-growing earnings engine on AI demand
bullets.body: MS analyst Erik Woodring raises HPE PT to $72 following Networking Day; HPE sees ~18% networking market growth through 2029 (~2x prior outlook) with HPE growing at similar high-teens CAGR implying share gains. Networking margins expected to scale to high 20% by FY29. FY27/FY28 EPS raised 3%/10% to $5.10/$5.76, 11-13% above Street. Bull case valuation $94. HPE also upgraded to Outperform by Daiwa.

bullets.title: ABNB: Upgraded to Overweight by KeyBanc; +1.3% pre-market
bullets.body: KeyBanc upgraded Airbnb to Overweight. Mizuho note separately highlights PayPal's branded checkout losing share to e-commerce partners like Airbnb.

bullets.title: RCL: Citi closes upside catalyst watch after +17% move; raises 2027 EPS to '20 handle'; Sandals well-received
bullets.body: Citi closes bullish RCL catalyst watch following +17% gain vs. -1% S&P over the past week. 2026 yield and EPS estimates raised; 2027 EPS targeted at '20 handle' despite fuel headwinds. Investors increasingly warming to Sandals acquisition. Rhine-Danube river levels at all-time lows but forecasts show steady improvement.

bullets.title: ADBE: GS maintains Sell; leadership transition to Chakravarthy on Dec 1 viewed as critical risk
bullets.body: Goldman Sachs maintains Sell on Adobe as Anil Chakravarthy takes CEO role December 1. GS cites intensifying AI competition and need to prove AI turnaround under new leadership. This is a key leadership transition moment for the stock.

bullets.title: HOOD: Wells Fargo initiates at equal weight with $125 PT; prediction market super-cycle thesis bullish
bullets.body: Wells Fargo initiates HOOD at equal weight with $125 PT (12% upside). Separately, HOOD management views prediction markets as at the start of a super cycle; prediction market industry ADV grew +57% MoM in September to record $2,600M. Underdog CEO presenting Oct 8; management refreshing strategy Oct 22 with capital allocation framework.

bullets.title: EQIX/DLR/IREN: JPM bullish on data center electrification plays; BTM generation critical for gigawatt-scale AI campuses
bullets.body: JPM identifies EQIX, DLR, and IREN as winners from AI data center power buildout. GPU power density has jumped to 40-100+ kW/server (AI era) vs. 3-10 kW/server (cloud era), requiring data centers to be designed as power systems first. Fiber builds faster/cheaper than solving power constraints; BTM natural gas/nuclear generation needed to avoid grid instability from synchronous GPU loads.

bullets.title: RBLX: DAUs +1% YoY 3QTD but JPM models -14% YoY in 3Q26 on difficult comps
bullets.body: JPM's September internet digest shows Roblox DAUs up only +1% YoY quarter-to-date, with September improving to +5% YoY supported by viral hits like 'Steal An Egg.' However, JPM models 3Q26 DAU growth declining -14% YoY due to difficult year-ago comparisons.
